newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks tumble at end as blue chips fall.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks tumble at end as blue chips fall.

text.p: Pakistani stocks tumbled at close on Thursday as blue chips fell on speculative selling and dealers said the index might slide further as investors were on the sidelines.

"All the active blue chips, including Hub Power and PTCL, fell on selling by speculators," dealer Ali Asghar said. "There is no buying interest from foreign and local investors, while local institutions are short of funds."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 18.09 points, or 1.15 percent, to end at 1,554.99. Losers led gainers 219 to 59. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
